			<p>
				The 2024 Global Traffic Scorecard provides three years of transportation data for a more granular and holistic analysis of mobility within the world's most-congested areas. It provides travel delay comparisons, costs of congestion to drivers and regions, and commuting trends based on the unique travel patterns within each metro area.
			</p>
			<p>
				The Scorecard utilizes up to date, observed commute trips to truly analyze and compare how travel behavior differs in more than 900 cities across the globe.

			<script>

				mapboxgl.accessToken = 'pk.eyJ1IjoidG9ueWphY29ic29uIiwiYSI6ImNrZGdncDR3eTFya2sydXBlbjdvcHJ2a2oifQ.JYoByYoMc7G9vF-_6-ev3w';

				const initialCenter = [-96.73531949493727, 35.795848606475104];
				const initialZoom = 4.0;
				const initialRotation = 0.0;

				const map = new mapboxgl.Map({
					container: 'map',
					style: 'mapbox://styles/seabmoby/ckoak2uyy07w117l0hfy5i3bc',
					zoom: initialZoom,
					center: initialCenter,
					pitch: 45,
					bearing: initialRotation,
					pitchWithRotate: false,
					antialias: true,
					projection: 'mercator',
					minZoom: 3.0,
					maxZoom: 9.0,
					// maxBounds: [
					// 		[-124.848974, 24.396308], // Southwest coordinates
					// 		[-66.93457, 52.384358]    // Northeast coordinates
					// ]
				});

				map.addControl(new mapboxgl.NavigationControl());

				class ResetControl {
					onAdd(map) {
							this.map = map;
							this.container = document.createElement('div');
							this.container.title = 'Reset Map';
							this.container.className = 'mapboxgl-ctrl mapboxgl-ctrl-group';
							const button = document.createElement('button');
							button.type = 'button';
							button.innerHTML = '<svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 17 17" style="padding-top:6px;" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M3.85971 2.2746C5.19732 1.26929 6.85967 0.673566 8.65978 0.673566C13.0753 0.673566 16.6597 4.25798 16.6597 8.67345C16.6597 13.0889 13.0753 16.6733 8.65978 16.6733C4.45117 16.6733 0.997963 13.4164 0.683379 9.28772C0.638565 8.70055 1.07859 8.18803 1.66575 8.1432C2.25291 8.09837 2.76544 8.53841 2.81027 9.12557C3.04123 12.1529 5.57401 14.5399 8.65978 14.5399C11.8975 14.5399 14.5262 11.9112 14.5262 8.67323C14.5262 5.43547 11.8975 2.80678 8.65978 2.80678C7.40535 2.80678 6.24224 3.20138 5.2881 3.87338H5.99313C6.58187 3.87338 7.05973 4.35125 7.05973 4.93999C7.05973 5.52883 6.58187 6.00669 5.99313 6.00669H2.79308C2.20371 6.00669 1.72639 5.52935 1.72639 4.93999V1.73995C1.72639 1.1512 2.20425 0.67334 2.79308 0.67334C3.38183 0.67334 3.85969 1.1512 3.85969 1.73995L3.85971 2.2746Z" fill="#000000"/></svg>';
							button.addEventListener('click', () => {
									map.easeTo({
										center: initialCenter,
										zoom: initialZoom,
										bearing: initialRotation
									});
							});
							this.container.appendChild(button);
							return this.container;
					}

					onRemove() {
							this.container.parentNode.removeChild(this.container);
							this.map = undefined;
					}
				}

				map.addControl(new ResetControl(), 'top-right');


				const modelOrigin = [-97.74285301048349, 30.265111822842304];
				const modelAltitude = 0;
				const modelRotate = [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0];
				const modelScale = mapboxgl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(modelOrigin, modelAltitude).meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits();

				const THREE = window.THREE;

				const modelAsMercatorCoordinate = mapboxgl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(
					modelOrigin,
					modelAltitude
				);

				const modelTransform = {
					translateX: modelAsMercatorCoordinate.x,
					translateY: modelAsMercatorCoordinate.y,
					translateZ: modelAsMercatorCoordinate.z,
					rotateX: modelRotate[0],
					rotateY: modelRotate[1],
					rotateZ: modelRotate[2],
					scale: modelAsMercatorCoordinate.meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits() * 1000
				};


				let currentHeightData = '2024_delay';
				let currentDataScaleFactor = 10;


				const customLayer = {
					id: '3d-model',
					type: 'custom',
					renderingMode: '3d',
					onAdd: function (map, gl) {
						console.log('onAdd');
						const width = gl.canvas.width;
						const height = gl.canvas.height;
						const viewportWidth = width * 0.5;
						const viewportHeight = height * 0.5;

						this.camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(
							-viewportWidth, // Left
							viewportWidth, // Right
							viewportHeight, // Top
							-viewportHeight, // Bottom
							0.1, // Near clipping plane
							100000 // Far clipping plane
						);

						this.scene = new THREE.Scene();

						const hemisphereLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x0099ff, 1.0); // skyColor, groundColor, intensity
						this.scene.add(hemisphereLight);


						this.cylinders = [];

						for (let i=0; i<_usCitiesData.length; i++) {
							const city = _usCitiesData[i];
							const cityMercatorCoordinate = getMercatorCoordinate(city.longitude, city.latitude, 0);
							const scaleFactor = 34.55;
							const offsetX = (cityMercatorCoordinate.x - modelAsMercatorCoordinate.x) * 1000 * scaleFactor;
							const offsetZ = (cityMercatorCoordinate.y - modelAsMercatorCoordinate.y) * 1000 * scaleFactor;
							let delay = city[currentHeightData] * currentDataScaleFactor;
							// console.log('delay', delay, city.urban_area);

							let material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
								color: 0x0099ff,
								transparent: true,
								opacity: 0.85
							});

							if (delay >= 0 && currentHeightData === 'delay_change_percent') {
								material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
									color: 0xff0000,
									transparent: true,
									opacity: 0.65
								});
							} else if (delay < 0 && currentHeightData === 'delay_change_percent') {
								material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
									color: 0x008800,
									transparent: true,
									opacity: 0.85
								});
								delay = Math.abs(delay);
							}

							if (currentHeightData === 'delay_change_percent') {
								document.querySelector('.data-selector-legend').style.display = 'grid';
							} else {
								document.querySelector('.data-selector-legend').style.display = 'none';
							}

							const radiusTop = 15;  // Radius at the top of the cylinder
							const radiusBottom = 15;  // Radius at the bottom of the cylinder
							const height = delay;  // Height of the cylinder
							const radialSegments = 32;  // Number of segmented faces around the circumference of the cylinder
							const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radiusTop, radiusBottom, height, radialSegments);

							const cylinder = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
							cylinder.position.set(offsetX, height / 2, offsetZ);
							this.scene.add(cylinder);

							this.cylinders.push(cylinder);
						}

						this.map = map;
						this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
							canvas: map.getCanvas(),
							context: gl,
							antialias: true,
							logarithmicDepthBuffer: true // Enable logarithmic depth buffer
						});
						this.renderer.autoClear = false;

						// map.getCanvas().addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove.bind(this));

					},
					render: function (gl, matrix) {
						const zoom = this.map.getZoom();
						const pitch = this.map.getPitch();

						// Calculate the orthographic camera's projection parameters based on zoom level
						const zoomLevel = zoom < 6 ? 6 : zoom; // Clamp the zoom level to a minimum of 6
						const distance = Math.pow(2, zoomLevel - 6); // Adjust the distance based on the zoom level
						const far = 100000 * distance; // Adjust the far clipping plane based on the distance
						const width = gl.canvas.width / distance;
						const height = gl.canvas.height / distance;

						// Update the orthographic camera's projection
						this.camera.left = -width / 2;
						this.camera.right = width / 2;
						this.camera.top = height / 2;
						this.camera.bottom = -height / 2;
						this.camera.near = 0.1;
						this.camera.far = far;
						this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

						const rotationX = new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationAxis(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), modelTransform.rotateX);
						const rotationY = new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationAxis(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), modelTransform.rotateY);
						const rotationZ = new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationAxis(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), modelTransform.rotateZ);

						const m = new THREE.Matrix4().fromArray(matrix);
						const l = new THREE.Matrix4()
							.makeTranslation(modelTransform.translateX, modelTransform.translateY, modelTransform.translateZ)
							.scale(new THREE.Vector3(modelTransform.scale, -modelTransform.scale, modelTransform.scale))
							.multiply(rotationX)
							.multiply(rotationY)
							.multiply(rotationZ);

						this.camera.projectionMatrix = m.multiply(l);
						this.renderer.resetState();
						this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
						this.map.triggerRepaint();
					}
				};


				function getMercatorCoordinate(lng, lat, altitude = 0) {
						const mercatorCoordinate = mapboxgl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat([lng, lat], altitude);
						return mercatorCoordinate;
				}




				const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
				tooltip.id = 'tooltip';
				tooltip.style.position = 'absolute';
				tooltip.style.backgroundColor = 'white';
				tooltip.style.padding = '5px';
				tooltip.style.border = '1px solid black';
				tooltip.style.display = 'none';
				document.body.appendChild(tooltip);

				const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
				const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

				function onMouseMove(event) {
					// Calculate normalized device coordinates (NDC) (-1 to +1) for mouse position
					mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
					mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;

					// Perform the intersection test
					raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, customLayer.camera);

					const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(customLayer.scene.children);

					if (intersects.length > 0) {
							const intersectedObject = intersects[0].object;

							// If there is a previously highlighted object and it's not the current intersected object
							if (customLayer.highlightedObject && customLayer.highlightedObject !== intersectedObject) {
									customLayer.highlightedObject.material.color.set(customLayer.highlightedObject.originalColor);
							}

							// Highlight the new object
							intersectedObject.originalColor = intersectedObject.material.color.getHex();
							intersectedObject.material.color.set(0xff0000);

							customLayer.highlightedObject = intersectedObject;

							// Update the tooltip
							const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
							tooltip.style.display = 'block';
							tooltip.style.left = event.clientX + 'px';
							tooltip.style.top = event.clientY + 'px';
							tooltip.innerHTML = `City: ${intersectedObject.userData.city}<br>Delay: ${intersectedObject.userData.delay}`;
					} else {
							// Reset the color of the previously highlighted object
							if (customLayer.highlightedObject) {
									customLayer.highlightedObject.material.color.set(customLayer.highlightedObject.originalColor);
									customLayer.highlightedObject = null;
							}

							// Hide the tooltip
							const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
							tooltip.style.display = 'none';
					}
			}

			document.querySelector('#radio-1').addEventListener('click', () => {
				currentHeightData = '2024_delay';
				currentDataScaleFactor = 10;
				if (map.getLayer('3d-model')) {
					map.removeLayer('3d-model');
				}
				if (map.getSource('3d-model')) {
					map.removeSource('3d-model');
				}
				map.addLayer(customLayer);
				map.setLayerZoomRange('3d-model', 0, 22);

			});

			document.querySelector('#radio-2').addEventListener('click', () => {
				currentHeightData = 'delay_change_percent';
				currentDataScaleFactor = 500;
				if (map.getLayer('3d-model')) {
					map.removeLayer('3d-model');
				}
				if (map.getSource('3d-model')) {
					map.removeSource('3d-model');
				}
				map.addLayer(customLayer);
				map.setLayerZoomRange('3d-model', 0, 22);
			});


			</script>

	</section>

						<h2 class="h1">
				The Economic Cost<br>
				of Congestion
			</h2>
			<div class="body-copy">
				<p>
					Traffic congestion occurs when demand for roadway travel exceeds the supply of roadways. As vehicular traffic builds, drivers, freight movers and bus riders lose time and spend fuel unproductively. That “lost time” has a value that we analyze in the 2024 Global Traffic Scorecard.
				</p>
				<p>
					In addition to lost time, negative externalities like freight delay, inflationary pressure and environmental impact are generally exacerbated due to traffic congestion. While not measured in this report, these externalities decrease our quality of life.
				</p>
				<p>
					Another large cost of travel is fuel. Throughout 2024, global oil prices resulted in a small decrease in fuel costs to motorists.
				</p>

	<section class="downtown-trips">

		<div class="column-text">
			<h2 class="h1">
				Downtown Trips
			</h2>
			<div class="body-copy">
				<p>
					Throughout the pandemic, metro areas around the world experienced significant drops in trips to and from city centers as workers shifted to telecommuting and hybrid schedules. In addition, other businesses, dependent on office workers heading into downtown, often adjusted schedules or reduced services due to fewer in-person customers. Between 2021 and 2024, however, most downtowns saw increases in both vehicle volumes and travel times, though many downtowns still sit below pre-COVID norms.
				</p>
			</div>

		<div class="downtown-graph-container">
			<div class="header">
				<h3 class="graph-title">
					2024 Trip Change &amp; Peak Travel Time Change
				</h3>

					<div class="bar-icon dark-blue"></div>

	<section data-wpr-lazyrender="1" class="multi-modal">
				<h2 class="h1">
			Shared Mobility Usage in 5 Select U.S. Cities
		</h2>
				<div class="chart-micromobility"></div>
		<div class="columns">
			<div class="column-1">
				<div class="body-copy">
					<p>
						The Federal Transit Administration defines shared mobility as "transportation services that are shared among users, including public transit; taxis and limos; bikesharing; carsharing (round-trip, one-way, and personal vehicle sharing); ridesharing (carpooling, vanpooling); ridesourcing; scooter sharing; shuttle services; neighborhood jitneys; and commercial delivery vehicles providing flexible goods movement."
					</p>
					<p>
						Over the last decade these transport modes have gained popularity in cities across the world. While these modes often replace car trips and provide first- and last-mile access, they also require cities to manage the curb and roadway differently, oversee their distribution and ensure compliance to deploy.
					</p>
				</div>
			</div>
			<div class="column-2">
				<div class="body-copy">
					<p>
						With the acquisition of Ride Report, INRIX bolstered its coverage of shared mobility data. The latest trends reveal micromobility use across 10 cities analyzed increased 17% year over year, indicating more people are returning to offices and are utilizing alternate and shared modes. A preview of five U.S. cities is below. Visit ridereport.org to view, analyze, and compare micromobility across all cities.
					</p>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</section>
